newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen starting flat to softer on U.S. cue.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen starting flat to softer on U.S. cue.

text.p: Shares were seen opening flat to softer on Monday after the Dow industrials edged lower on Friday but the technology-heavy Nasdaq composite index and Nokia's ADR closed steady on Wall Street, brokers said.
"The U.S. market was flat," one broker said, predicting a neutral trend for the day.
Forestries were seen under some pressure and dragging the general index after the S&P index tracking U.S. paper makers fell almost two percent on Friday.
Nokia closed at about 450.10 markka in New York on Friday, more or less matching its 449.90 Helsinki close.
One broker said he expected Nokia to hold firm this week ahead of its half-year earnings report next Monday.
The strong dollar was seen supporting Finnish stocks.
